name: Linen
summary: A private training studio, by appointment: the trainer's week as a printed appointment page. Monday to Saturday across, one row per hour; spoken-for hours stay blank, hours already gone shade as passed, and the few open hours are printed in ink and ask for themselves on WhatsApp. A photograph of the trainer sits over the spoken-for middle of the week. Linen ground, warm black ink, one walnut accent. Ibarra Real Nova throughout, every time in its own lining figures set in equal boxes. Then "your first month": where, how often, the first session minute by minute, every date and the cost. For independent personal trainers and private studios.
